frases: Your shed is going to sink!
You set it right on the grass, because it looked flat enough.
The soft soil washes out under one corner, and the shed starts to lean.
The door jams. The floor rots.
First, dig out the grass, and add four to six inches of crushed stone.
Next, pack it down tight, and make it level.
Now the shed sits on a solid base, and the water drains away.
Same shed. Same door. No more jamming!
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
